title: Which Taylor Swift Era Matches Your Personality?
description: Discover which Taylor Swift era matches your personality!

options.text: Dancing to 1989 with glitter and neon lights
Singing acoustic songs in an intimate venue
Joining a massive crowd at the Eras Tour
Watching from a VIP box with perfect view

questions.text: When someone wrongs you, you usually...

options.text: Write a scathing breakup song about them
Write a subtle revenge song (like All Too Well)
Plot your revenge like 'Look What You Made Me Do'

questions.text: Your love language in relationships is...

options.text: Grand romantic gestures (like in Love Story)
Quiet, deep connection (like in Cornelia Street)
Surprise them with gifts (like in Bejeweled)
Blast All Too Well (10 minute version)
Delete all photos and move on (like Clean)
Listen to sad songs on repeat for days

questions.text: Your friends would describe you as...

options.text: The life of the party - always dramatic and fun
The wise one - always giving advice
The loyal one - always there when needed
The mysterious one - hard to read
Upbeat and make you want to dance

questions.text: When making important life decisions, you...

options.text: Going to a party or club
Writing about it in a journal
To be respected as an expert

questions.text: When someone asks about your ex, you...

options.text: Have a whole playlist about them
Give a vague answer and move on

results.title: 1989 Era
results.description: You're the 1989 era - fun, outgoing, and always the life of the party! You love big gestures and aren't afraid to be the center of attention.

results.title: Folklore/Evermore Era
results.description: You're the Folklore/Evermore era - deep, introspective, and beautifully complex. You find magic in the quiet moments.

results.title: Fearless Era
results.description: You're the Fearless era - brave, optimistic, and inspires everyone around you. You go after what you want without hesitation.

results.title: Evermore Era
results.description: You're the Evermore era - wise, mysterious, and deeply intuitive. You see things others miss.

results.title: Midnights Era
results.description: You're the Midnights era - complex, sometimes contradictory, but always fascinating. You embrace all sides of yourself.

results.title: Red (Taylor's Version)
results.description: You're the Red era - emotionally rich, deeply felt, and brilliantly chaotic. You feel everything intensely.

results.title: Reputation Era
results.description: You're the Reputation era - bold, unapologetic, and fierce. You don't care what others think.

results.title: Speak Now Era
results.description: You're the Speak Now era - creative, passionate, and speak your truth. You write your own story.

results.title: The Tortured Poets Department
results.description: You're the TTPD era - intellectual, complex, and deeply analytical. You overthink everything but that's your superpower.

results.title: Debut Era
results.description: You're the Debut era - authentic, country roots, and true to yourself. You started from humble beginnings and stayed genuine.

results.title: Lover Era
results.description: You're the Lover era - romantic, colorful, and all about love in all forms. You wear your heart on your sleeve.

results.title: Red (Acoustic)
results.description: You're the acoustic side of Red - quietly powerful, deeply emotional, and always there for your people.

results.title: Miss Eras Era
results.description: You're the Miss Eras era - determined, competitive, and always working toward your next goal. You never stop.

results.title: Midnights (3am Edition)
results.description: You're the 3am edition of Midnights - private, mysterious, but surprisingly deep when someone gets to know you.

results.title: Eras Tour Energy
results.description: You're the Eras Tour - a master of reinvention, ambitious, and always evolving. You've got a plan for everything.

results.title: Vault Tracks
results.description: You're the Vault tracks - the hidden gems that not everyone finds, but those who do are rewarded with brilliance.
